title: Tomorrowland
metaDescription: Tomorrowland is a large electronic-music festival held at De Schorre in Boom, Belgium

overview.about: Tomorrowland is the world's most famous electronic dance music festival, held each summer in Boom, Belgium. Renowned for its fairytale main stages, elaborate production and global following, it sells out almost instantly and draws fans from more than 200 countries.
overview.nextEvent: The next Tomorrowland runs over two weekends in July in Boom, Belgium. Its vast, theatrically designed stages host the biggest names in electronic music, and the festival ships in fans from all over the world.
